title: Palette Selection Plan
description: A palette/arrangement selection plan for computational photo composition: the color space and delta-E method used for comparisons, the diversity-aware selection algorithm and its parameters, and the measured diagnostics (diversity, saturation spread, temperature coherence, Sinkhorn convergence, and color-grading blend ratio) that palette_audit.mjs checks against this skill's own failure modes.

colorSpace.description: Color space used for all distance/delta-E calculations. Must be 'lab' for perceptually valid comparisons; 'rgb'/'hsv' produce Perceptual Mismatch.

deltaEMethod.description: Color-difference metric. CIEDE2000 is most accurate, deltaE94 is a middle ground, euclidean LAB distance is a fast approximation.

lambda.description: Harmony/diversity trade-off weight. Values above ~0.8 risk Diversity Collapse.

algo.description: Selection algorithm: Maximal Marginal Relevance, Determinantal Point Process, pure Earth-Mover Distance matching, or flat/unweighted selection.

maxPairwiseEmd.description: Maximum pairwise Earth-Mover Distance between selected palettes. Below 0.3 indicates Diversity Collapse.

chromaStdDev.description: Standard deviation of chroma across selected palettes. Below 15 indicates Saturation Monotony.

hueCoverageDegrees.description: Degrees of hue circle spanned by the selection. >120 for diverse selections, <60 for intentionally monochromatic ones.

maxAdjacentTempDeltaB.description: Maximum absolute LAB b-axis difference between temporally/spatially adjacent selections. Above 40 indicates Temperature Incoherence.

iterations.description: Sinkhorn algorithm iterations to convergence. Above 50 indicates EMD Optimization Failure.

relError.description: Sinkhorn relative error at termination. Above 0.01 indicates EMD Optimization Failure.

blendRatio.description: Fraction of global color-grading correction applied (e.g. warm/cool white-balance normalization). Above 0.4 loses photo authenticity.
